integrity_statement: Proof uses explicitly stated classical quadratic Gauss sums; all-prime statements are analytical. Finite direct-DFT checks are supplementary. Previously published CAZAC phase parameters are explicitly credited; earlier equivalent endpoint calculations remain a bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to zero-DC quadratic-residue two-phase unimodular masks on prime cyclic groups. The finite-cycle imaginary-power illustration is restricted to five vertices. No claim of arbitrary phase-mask optimality or independent validation.
title: Sharp endpoint profiles of quadratic-residue phase multipliers on prime cycles
